data.one_liner: Extends bloc to broadcast state changes to stream channels
data.what_it_does: Adds a BroadcastCubit and BroadcastBloc that can subscribe to StreamChannel objects. When the bloc emits a new state, all subscribed channels receive the state as a stream event.
use_when: Need to expose bloc state to other parts of the app via streams
Integrating with stream-based APIs or services
Want multiple listeners to react to state changes without duplicating bloc instances
avoid_when: Already using a different state‑management solution that provides broadcasting
You don't need to share state via streams
strengths: Seamless integration with existing bloc code
No additional code generation or build_runner steps
Supports all platforms supported by bloc
weaknesses: Only works with bloc; not a drop‑in for other patterns
